senses.zh_definition: 【暂按专名解释】戈雅，西班牙画家及版画家弗朗西斯科·德·戈雅的姓氏；输入词形的实际所指尚未确认。
senses.en_definition: Provisionally, Goya: the surname of Spanish painter and printmaker Francisco de Goya; the intended referent of the supplied token remains unconfirmed.
senses.ms_definition: Secara sementara, nama keluarga Francisco de Goya, pelukis dan penghasil seni cetak Sepanyol; rujukan sebenar bentuk dalam paket belum dapat dipastikan.
senses.nuances: 这是明确标注的专名推定，并非已核实的马来语普通词义或 DBP 官方释义。以下搭配与例句仅适用于画家 Goya；搭配频率未经核实。画家身份可由 [普拉多博物馆人物资料](https://www.museodelprado.es/coleccion/artista/francisco-de-goya-y-lucientes/39568a17-81b5-4d6f-84fa-12db60780812) 核实。

etymology.historical_story: Goya is securely documented as the surname of Francisco de Goya, the Spanish artist born in 1746 who died in 1828. Museum collections preserve both his paintings and prints. This establishes a possible cultural referent, not the identity of the lowercase token in the packet, its surname etymology, or its status as a Malay common noun. [Museo del Prado](https://www.museodelprado.es/coleccion/artista/francisco-de-goya-y-lucientes/39568a17-81b5-4d6f-84fa-12db60780812)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若语境谈画作，就把 Goya 与中文“戈雅”及画框联系起来；这是专名记忆提示，不能据此确定输入词的本义。
